title: Obedience Is the Fruit of Faith
opening: Faith is more than hearing a sermon. God’s Word calls us to respond with practical obedience in our homes, work, school, church, and community.
points: Identify one clear biblical instruction from your reading.
Put it into action in a specific and realistic way.
Ask God and trusted believers to help you remain accountable.
reflection: What truth will you put into practice before the day ends?
prayer: Father, help me not only to hear Your Word but to live it. Give me a humble and obedient heart. Amen.
ministry: Grace Fire Deliverance Healing Global Word Ministry
author: Daily Bible Teaching Team
